edits.current: "subtype": "In PHP-Wasm, checked nominal values preserve all nineteen tested primitive representations on wasm32: null for Unit; bool; PHP int for UInt8, UInt16, Int8, Int16, Int32 and ISize; Brick\\Math\\BigInteger for UInt32, UInt64, Int64, Nat, Int and USize; float for Float32 and Float; string for String and Char; and generated Bytes for ByteArray. USize and ISize use 32-bit ranges. Generated final readonly classes carry record and active-variant fields without proof fields. Each input site retains its selected checked constructor and accepted normalization; only the active variant branch is checked. Fixed-width overflow, wrong host types, invalid Unicode scalars, malformed Bytes, refused non-finite floats and invalid Fin siblings reject before Lean dispatch. Rejection preserves the complete caller value, including signed zero and embedded NUL data, and later valid calls succeed. Copied results project proof-backed payloads without input constructor selections, including standalone result-only packages."
